offfield_markets.label: Special-event game participants (Field of Dreams teams)
offfield_markets.target: Whether a named club is confirmed as a participant in a special-event game (2027 Field of Dreams), resolving on selection, with all clubs No if no game is staged.
offfield_markets.mechanism: Participation is a league scheduling decision: first whether the special-event game is staged at all (venue readiness, broadcast slot, schedule calendar and the Dec 1 2026 CBA expiry), then which two clubs are chosen (distance to the site, marketability, recency of use, home-date cost, schedule-matrix fit), announced with the schedule release after leaks of uneven credibility. Team quality and player performance play no role.

attach.why: A lockout after the Dec 1 2026 CBA expiry can delay the 2027 schedule release or cancel the event, sending every club market to No.
Leaks about participants precede the official announcement and must be weighted by each source's historical reliability.
Pre-registered statistics-based narrative flags (milestone, comeback, first-year, positional scarcity, team surprise) enter the vote models as terms fitted per electorate.
KXMLBTEAMSTAT (team strikeouts leader) is a thirty-staff order statistic computed by this engine.
Single-hitter season thresholds filed here (50 HR, 50 HR plus 40 SB) are tails of the joint power-speed season distribution.
The playoff leader and series MVP markets (stage s6) depend on how many playoff games and plate appearances a player gets.
The team strikeout leader (stage s8) is batters faced times each staff's strikeout rate.
Team strikeout and season threshold races (stage s8) need games remaining and totals to date.
Series MVP markets (stage s6) are the team series-win probability times the player credit share.
Best/worst record, 100-loss and losing-streak series filed here are thirty-team order statistics simulated by this engine.
KXMLBWSTREAK (longest winning streak, filed here) is a run-length extreme over every team's remaining schedule.
All-30-team talent posteriors with projection vintage feed the order-statistic engine for the league-wide record and streak series filed here.
2027 season futures resolve on a season whose length depends on a lockout after the Dec 1 2026 CBA expiry.
Exit before 15 outs and the reliever share of innings 1-5 are read off the shared starter exit hazard.
KXMLBF7 and KXMLBF3 windows (stage s6) need per-inning run rates by inning index to extend or cut the five-inning model.
The F7 window (stage s6) includes two innings that are mostly relief, so bullpen quality enters the seven-inning result.
For F7 the use of setup relievers in innings 6-7 by score state decides the late part of the window (stage s6).
Postseason starters get shorter leashes and openers are more common, which changes the batters-faced budget (stage s1).
Beat reports of pitch limits, illness or role changes precede official moves (stage s1).
Opposing offence quality raises pitch counts and early removal, shortening the strikeout budget (stage s2).
Outs recorded is a first-passage time of the shared starter exit hazard; exit_boundary_mass is its outs-lattice readout.
The confirmed opposing order sets out-rate by slot against the starter (stage s3).
Batters faced and exit states for inherited runners come from the shared starter exit hazard with its runs-allowed term.
The plate-appearance simulation propagates base-out states across innings so each inning-index strike gets consistent run probabilities (stage s2).
Weather delays and called games drive the Fair Price branch of every inning market (stage s5).

hitter_rbis_runs_sb.label: Hitter RBIs and stolen bases (single game)

attach.why: Start probability before the card posts sets whether the market settles on the count or at fair price (stage s1).
Day-to-day injuries raise scratch risk and early removal (stage s1).
Supplies the probability the listed opposing starter is replaced and the replacement's hand for the opposing-hand start mixture.
The return market (stage s5) depends on roster need: a club with a weak replacement activates a returning player sooner.

unreg:player_and_team_counting_specials.label: MLB postseason league counts, player home-run exposure and pitcher scoreless streaks
unreg:player_and_team_counting_specials.target: Postseason league totals (walk-offs, home runs) over all playoff games; a named hitter's home runs across one playoff series or inside a date window; a named pitcher reaching N consecutive scoreless innings.
contract_types: Player home run in date window
unreg:player_and_team_counting_specials.mechanism: Three families share only their exposure logic. Postseason counts are sums over a random number of playoff games set by bracket paths and series lengths, with per-game walk-off and home-run rates. Player home-run exposure is a hitter's per-PA home-run rate times plate appearances over the games of one series or a date window, with injury absorbing exposure. The scoreless streak is a survival over consecutive outs with no run charged, capped by remaining starts before the regular season ends.

unreg:pitch_velocity_extremes.label: Season maximum pitch velocity thresholds, plus league-wide season feats filed under KXMLBSTAT
unreg:pitch_velocity_extremes.target: Whether a named or any pitcher throws a pitch at or above a velocity threshold in the season including playoffs; also (KXMLBSTAT) whether any player achieves a rare season feat: individual no-hitter, perfect game, 4+ HR or 2+ grand slams in a game, 20+ strikeout game, 500+ ft home run, 20 pitcher wins, 50 HR plus 50 SB.
unreg:pitch_velocity_extremes.mechanism: Two unrelated mechanisms share this filing. Velocity thresholds: the season's fastest pitch is the maximum of a bounded per-pitch speed distribution over a few thousand near-peak fastballs from a small pool of elite throwers, so exceedance needs a pitcher whose ceiling sits near the line, max-effort exposure, favourable situations, health and a tracking reading above the line. KXMLBSTAT feats: league-wide unions over remaining team-games of tiny per-game rates (no-hitters, multi-HR games, 20-strikeout games, 500-foot drives) set by the league strikeout and power environment and starter length, or season threshold races (20 wins, 50/50) among the few candidates on pace. They belong in a separate season-feats archetype that this pass could not create.

attach.why: KXMLBDEBUT (filed here) depends on 40-man status, options and roster need for a first MLB appearance (stage s7).
